hero.subHeading: We work alongside your team to understand the whole platform, make risk visible and turn the right decisions into practical progress.

sections.body: Frontier works across strategy, architecture, integration and implementation. That means the platforms we design are grounded in delivery reality — and the platforms we build are aligned to long-term operational goals.

cards.body: We help you understand the right platform direction, architecture and operating model for your environment.
cards.title: Technical consultancy

cards.body: We bring together cloud, infrastructure, Kubernetes, security and delivery tooling into coherent platforms.
cards.title: Product integration

cards.body: We work alongside your teams to build, migrate, modernise and enable platforms in production.
cards.title: Hands-on delivery

sections.heading: We do not just advise on platforms. We build them.

sections.body: Every engagement is different, but our work usually follows a simple pattern: understand the reality, design the platform, integrate the right technologies, build the foundation, and enable teams to operate it.

cards.body: Understand constraints, risks, systems, teams and operating reality.

cards.body: Help teams adopt, operate and evolve the platform with confidence.

sections.heading: A practical path from complexity to control.

cards.body: We work across the full platform stack — from bare metal, Linux, provisioning and virtualisation through to cloud, Kubernetes and developer platforms.
cards.title: From metal to Kubernetes

cards.body: We work with product companies and ecosystem partners, but our advice is shaped by your environment rather than a single vendor architecture.
cards.title: Not vendor-led
